name: Shop Explorer – Advanced WooCommerce Management & Analytics Dashboard
author: wpazleen

sections.description:
Shop Explorer is the most comprehensive WooCommerce management system that revolutionizes how you manage your online store. Built with modern technology and featuring advanced analytics, bulk operations, intelligent filtering, and an intuitive design – it’s the WooCommerce dashboard you’ve always wanted.

🚀 Activity Guard | 📖 Documentation | 💬 Pro Support

Support & Connect

Let’s grow, connect, and build together! 🚀

  • 🤝 Join our community on Facebook: Facebook

  • 🎥 Subscribe to our YouTube channel: YouTube

  • 🐦 Follow us on X (Twitter): X / Twitter

  • 🌟 Love Shop Explorer?: Leave a Review

🎯 Why Choose Shop Explorer?

Replace the slow, cluttered WooCommerce admin with a lightning-fast, modern interface that makes store management effortless. Whether you’re managing 10 products or 10,000, Shop Explorer scales with your business needs.

Say goodbye to the slow, cluttered WooCommerce dashboard. Shop Explorer makes everything feel instant, clean and effortless.

⚡ Core Features:

1. 📊 Advanced Revenue Analytics Dashboard

Transform your store data into actionable insights with comprehensive analytics:

  • Real-time Revenue Tracking – Interactive column charts powered by Recharts
  • Daily, Weekly, Monthly Breakdowns – Detailed revenue analysis across time periods
  • Average Order Value Analytics – Track and optimize your AOV
  • Top-Performing Products Analysis – Identify your best sellers
  • Custom Date Range Filtering – Today, Yesterday, Last 7/15/30 days, or custom ranges
  • Professional Visualizations – Beautiful, responsive charts using Recharts library
  • Export Analytics Data – Download reports in CSV format for external analysis
  • Growth Indicators – Track revenue growth with percentage changes
  • Order Trends – Visualize order patterns and seasonal trends

Key Metrics Displayed:
– Total Revenue with growth percentage
– Total Orders with status breakdown
– Average Order Value with comparisons
– Product catalog statistics
– Daily/Weekly/Monthly averages

2. 🛒 Powerful Order Management

Manage orders with unprecedented speed and efficiency:

Order Browsing & Filtering:
– Lightning-fast order table with pagination
– Advanced search by customer name, email, product, order ID
– Filter by order status (Pending, Processing, Completed, etc.)
– Date range filtering with quick presets
– Price range filters (Min/Max total)
– Item count filters (Min/Max items per order)
– Real-time search with instant results

Sorting Options:
– Sort by: Order Date, Total Price, Item Count, Customer Name
– Ascending/Descending order
– Client-side sorting for instant results

Quick Date Filters:
– Last 7 Days
– Last 10 Days
– Last 30 Days
– Last 60 Days
– Last 90 Days
– Custom date range picker

Bulk Operations:
– Bulk status updates with intelligent thresholds
– Bulk order export (CSV/Excel)
– Progress tracking for bulk operations
– Validation to prevent accidental changes
– Batch processing for large datasets

Order Details:
– Complete order information view
– Customer details and billing/shipping addresses
– Order items with product details
– Order notes management (add, edit, delete)
– Order status history
– Payment and shipping information
– Refund processing

Order Actions:
– Create new orders
– Edit existing orders
– Delete orders (with trash/permanent options)
– Add/update order notes
– Process refunds
– Update order status
– Email notifications

3. 📦 Advanced Product Management

Comprehensive product management with bulk editing capabilities:

Product Browsing & Filtering:
– Fast product table with advanced filtering
– Search by product name, SKU, description
– Filter by product type (Simple, Variable, Grouped, External)
– Category and tag filtering
– Price range filters (Min/Max price)
– Stock quantity filters (Min/Max stock)
– Featured products filter
– On-sale products filter
– Stock status filtering (In Stock, Out of Stock, Low Stock)

Sorting Options:
– Sort by: Date Created, Product Name, Price, Stock Quantity, SKU
– Ascending/Descending order
– Instant client-side sorting

Product Attributes:
– Featured: Filter featured products only, non-featured, or all
– On Sale: Filter products on sale, not on sale, or all
– Quick access to promotional products

Bulk Product Editing:
– Bulk price updates with percentage-based changes
– Bulk stock management
– Bulk category/tag assignments
– Bulk status changes (publish, draft, private)
– Bulk featured status toggle
– Intelligent validation engine
– Progress tracking with real-time updates
– Threshold system to prevent accidental mass changes
– Batch processing for thousands of products

Product Editor:
– Complete product information management
– Product variations support
– Image management and gallery
– Category and tag assignment
– Custom fields and attributes
– SEO-friendly product updates
– Inventory management
– Pricing (regular and sale prices)
– Product description with WYSIWYG editor
– Short description
– Product data tabs (General, Inventory, Shipping, etc.)

Variation Management:
– Create and manage product variations
– Bulk variation generation
– Variation-specific pricing and stock
– Variation images
– Variation attributes

Attribute Management:
– Create and manage product attributes
– Attribute terms management
– Global attributes
– Product-specific attributes

4. 👥 Customer Management System

Complete customer database management:

Customer Features:
– Customer list with advanced filtering
– Search by name, email, username
– Customer activity tracking
– Purchase history
– Customer lifetime value (CLV) tracking
– Order count per customer
– Total spent per customer
– Registration date
– Last order date

Customer Editor:
– Create new customers

– Billing and shipping addresses
– Customer notes
– Account status management
– Role assignment

Customer Analytics:
– New vs returning customers
– Customer acquisition patterns
– Top customers by revenue
– Customer segmentation
– Export customer data (CSV)

Bulk Customer Operations:
– Bulk customer export
– Bulk email notifications
– Customer data management

5. 🔧 Smart Bulk Operations

Intelligent bulk editing with safety features:

Threshold System:
– Set minimum/maximum limits for bulk updates
– Warning prompts for large operations
– Confirmation dialogs for critical changes
– Prevents accidental mass modifications

Progress Tracking:
– Real-time progress bars
– Success/failure counts
– Detailed operation logs

Batch Processing:
– Handle thousands of records efficiently
– Configurable batch sizes (default: 5000)
– Optimized database queries
– Memory-efficient processing
– Server load management

Bulk Edit Optimization (PRO):
– Optimize mode for large datasets
– Configurable batch sizes
– Threshold warnings
– Performance monitoring

6. 📈 Business Intelligence Features

Comprehensive analytics and reporting:

Dashboard Metrics:
– Total revenue with growth indicators
– Order statistics (total, pending, processing, completed)
– Product inventory status
– Low stock alerts
– Average order value
– Daily/weekly/monthly averages

Revenue Analytics:
– Interactive column charts
– Daily revenue breakdown
– Order count trends
– Average order value trends
– Period comparisons
– Export to CSV

Top Products:
– Best-selling products by revenue
– Best-selling products by quantity
– Product performance metrics
– Sales trends per product

Recent Activity:
– Real-time activity feed
– Order updates
– Product changes
– Customer registrations
– System events

7. ⚙️ Flexible Configuration

Extensive settings and customization options:

General Settings:
– Database mode (enabled by default)

– Auto-sync settings (coming soon)
– Sync interval configuration

WooCommerce Settings:

Notification Settings:

– Sync status alerts

Perfect For:
* E-commerce store owners managing large inventories

Transform your WooCommerce experience today! Shop Explorer isn’t just a plugin – it’s a complete store management solution that grows with your business.
sections.installation:
🚀 Quick Installation (Recommended)

  1. Install via WordPress Admin:

    • Go to Plugins → Add New in your WordPress dashboard
    • Search for “Shop Explorer”
    • Click “Install Now” and then “Activate”

  2. Manual Installation:

    • Download the plugin zip file
    • Upload to /wp-content/plugins/ directory
    • Extract the files
    • Activate through the ‘Plugins’ menu

  3. Initial Setup:

    • Navigate to “Shop Explorer” in your WordPress dashboard
    • Complete the quick setup wizard
    • Configure your preferred settings
    • Start managing your store like a pro!
sections.faq:
🤔 Is Shop Explorer compatible with my WooCommerce setup?

Yes! Shop Explorer is designed to work seamlessly with any WooCommerce installation. It supports all product types, variations, and WooCommerce extensions.

📊 How accurate are the analytics and reports?

Shop Explorer pulls data directly from your WooCommerce database in real-time, ensuring 100% accuracy. All calculations are performed using WooCommerce’s native functions.

🔧 Can I bulk edit thousands of products safely?

Absolutely! Our intelligent threshold system and validation engine prevent accidental data corruption. You can set limits and the system will warn you before making large changes.

💾 Will this slow down my website?

No! Shop Explorer is performance-optimized with efficient database queries, caching, and lazy loading. It actually improves admin performance compared to the default WooCommerce interface.

🔌 Does it conflict with other plugins?

Shop Explorer is built following WordPress coding standards and is compatible with most WooCommerce plugins. If you encounter any conflicts, our support team is ready to help.

📈 Can I export my data and analytics?

Yes! You can export orders, products, and customers data in CSV format for external analysis or backup purposes.

🆘 What kind of support do you provide?

We provide comprehensive documentation, video tutorials, and responsive support through the WordPress.org forums and our website.
